title: Textures
note: Every picture the game draws, by world, then category, then type, then name. Built by tools/build-sprites-manifest.cjs from the game's own tables (CITY_SURFACES, CITY_TD_ART and the object and creature tables).

types.label: Park (grass)
types.rule: About 8% of lots; corners rounded; trees and rubble on it block; at least one clear cell of sidewalk from any other park and from the shore. Round 424: each park lays one grass from its folder over the whole park (Round 430: only one, never mixed), tiled 140px; with no grass art, the base overgrowth.

types.label: Road (asphalt)
types.rule: One texture for every road and alley (Round 430, owner: never mix textures without a border between them); main roads 100px, alleys 50px; crossings exactly as wide as the roads meeting in them.

types.label: Sea
types.rule: Only along the city edge, never inland; whole 50px grid cells, corners rounded.

types.label: Sidewalk paving
types.rule: All ground that is not road, sea, sand, lot or park. One paving per city block (the first slot entry on half the blocks), so it only changes across a street. The squares where objects stand are sidewalk too.

types.label: Under buildings (lot footing)
types.rule: Fills a building's whole lot; a 4px footing shows round the building. Lots lie wholly on their block, never over a street.

types.label: Waterfront (beach sand)
types.rule: Exactly one grid cell wide round the sea; meets the sea with no border.

types.label: Curb (kerb along every road)
types.rule: A kerb-stone strip along both edges of every road, on the sidewalk side, bent round corners.

types.label: Park edge (kerb round the grass)
types.rule: One strip per park, round its rounded outline, on a solid base.

types.label: Waterfront edge (shoreline strip)
types.rule: Laid along the outline where the sand meets the paving, bent round corners.

types.label: Building walls (one floor)
types.rule: Floor by floor, each starting and ending on plain wall between windows (CITY_TD_GAPS); at least 3 floors (Round 427), 42px each; a shallow lot has fewer floors rather than squeezed ones.

types.label: Destroyed buildings (burnt-out wall, one floor)
types.rule: About 1 building in 8 is a ruin (a fixed hash of the lot; never a yard or forecourt). Round 439 (owner): an ordinary roof and parapet with a large hole in it (props/roof-hole/; nothing until that art comes), no rooftop kit, no rubble, no shopfront and no signs; its walls are these, floor by floor between window holes, at least 3 floors.

types.label: Downtown (tech quarter): roofs
types.rule: Every building in this quarter, tiled 160px.

types.label: Downtown (tech quarter): street floor
types.rule: The street floor of a building in this quarter whose street is to the south.

types.label: Downtown (tech quarter): walls (one floor)
types.rule: The upper floors of every building in this quarter (chronoDistrict), fitted floor by floor between windows.

types.label: Garden quarter: roofs
types.rule: Every building in this quarter, tiled 160px.

types.label: Garden quarter: street floor
types.rule: The street floor of a building in this quarter whose street is to the south.

types.label: Garden quarter: walls (one floor)
types.rule: The upper floors of every building in this quarter (chronoDistrict), fitted floor by floor between windows.

types.label: Homes district: roofs
types.rule: Every building in the homes quarter (chronoDistrict), tiled 160px like the other roofs.

types.label: Homes district: walls (one floor)
types.rule: Every building in the homes quarter: 3 or 4 floors, no shopfront and no signs; fitted floor by floor between windows (CITY_TD_GAPS).

types.label: Market quarter: roofs
types.rule: Every building in this quarter, tiled 160px.

types.label: Market quarter: street floor
types.rule: The street floor of a building in this quarter whose street is to the south.

types.label: Roofs
types.rule: One per building part, tiled 160px; a raised parapet and a cast shadow; rooftop props (props/) sized per kind.

types.label: Shopfronts (street floor)
types.rule: The street floor of a building whose street is to the south, fitted like a wall.

types.label: Air-conditioning units
types.rule: Stands on roofs, sized per kind, never over a neighbour.

types.label: Cargo (dock yards)
types.rule: Only on the front of a building whose street is in front; never stretched.

types.label: Rubble (parks and ruins)
types.rule: Lies in parks (2 to 4, clear of trees) and on ruined floors; in parks it blocks the way.

types.label: Street lights
types.rule: Along both kerbs of the main roads, about every 150px, the sides staggered; its post blocks the way.

types.label: Traffic lights
types.rule: On two opposite corners of a crossing where three or more main roads meet; its post blocks the way.

types.label: Traffic signs
types.rule: Where an alley leaves a main road, on one side of its mouth; its post blocks the way.

types.label: Trees

types.label: Vehicles
